| Verified via FindAGrave: https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/131722949/delphine-davis (Buried at Valhalla Gardens of Memory and Mausoleum)
[Correction, obituary-dates package 2026-11-27: the Find a Grave memorial 131722949 referenced above (Valhalla Gardens) is a different Delphine Davis, not this woman. Delphine Mae Davis, daughter of George A. Davis and Pearl Mae Thompson as this profile records: born 6 Oct 1939 near Millsboro, died 20 Aug 2002 at Beebe Medical Center, Lewes, per her funeral program, memorial card, and newspaper obituary, supplied by Jequan Davis; the 1918-1968 dates formerly here are superseded under his obituary-override rule.]

The former burial entry (9 Nov 1968, Find a Grave memorial 131722949, Valhalla Gardens) belongs to a different woman and its citation is detached to the register.
